python3 -c "
import cv2
import numpy as np

img = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0062.png')

# Front face top edge is at r=437. Let's find left and right ends at r=440
row440 = img[440, :, :]
# front face is BGR ~ [238, 244, 244]
mask440 = (row440[:, 0] > 230) & (row440[:, 1] > 230) & (row440[:, 2] > 230)
xs440 = np.where(mask440)[0]
print('Front face x at r=440:', xs440.min(), xs440.max())

# And at r=500
mask500 = (img[500, :, 0] > 230) & (img[500, :, 1] > 230) & (img[500, :, 2] > 230)
xs500 = np.where(mask500)[0]
print('Front face x at r=500:', xs500.min(), xs500.max())

# Top face back edge:
# At r=335:
for r in range(330, 345):
    m = (img[r, :, 0] < 210) & (img[r, :, 0] > 180) & (img[r, :, 1] < 210) & (img[r, :, 1] > 180)
    xs = np.where(m)[0]
    if len(xs) > 0:
        print(f'r={r}: top face x=[{xs.min()}, {xs.max()}], width={xs.max()-xs.min()}')
"
